blocks.text: MANILA – The Supreme Court (SC) has ordered Congress to fulfill its constitutional duty to enact a law prohibiting political dynasties “at the earliest opportunity.” The high tribunal issued the directive after, during its session last Aug. 26, it unanimously declared that Article II, Section 26 of the Constitution requires Congress to pass the anti-political dynasty law, and that failure to do so for 39 years constitutes grave abuse of discretion. In a statement on Wednesday, the SC said its en banc granted the consolidated petitions for certiorari and mandamus as the petitioners challenged Congress’ prolonged failure to pass a law […]...
